data.name: Floria
data.gender_notes: Floria is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word floris, meaning 'flower' or 'bloom'. In Greek mythology, Flora is the goddess of flowers and the season of spring. This name signifies growth, renewal, and beauty. The name Floria carries the meaning “Blooming, flourishing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Floria usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming, flourishing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the blossoming of the soul and the spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Floria belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blooming, flourishing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Floria total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם פלוריה נגזר מהמילה העברית 'פרח', שפירושה לפרוח, לצמוח ולהתפתח. הוא קשור לנושאים של צמיחה רוחנית ופריחה של הנפש. השם משויך לאיכויות של שגשוג והתפתחות אישית בקרב המאמינים.

in_greek.name: Φλωρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φλωρία προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'άνθος', που σημαίνει λουλούδι ή άνθιση. Συμβολίζει την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την αναγέννηση μέσα από την πίστη. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα συνδέεται με την ιδέα της πνευματικής άνθισης και της αναζήτησης της αιώνιας ζωής.

in_latin.name: Floria
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Floria derivatur a latino 'flos', quod significat florem seu floritionem. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc coniungitur cum conceptu spiritualis crescentiae et floritionis animae. Est imago renovationis et spei aeternae per fidem.

in_english.name: Floria

The name conveys a sense of beauty, purity, and spiritual maturity.
